arguments.assumptions: FY2027 period dates are a 52-week analyst timing assumption anchored only to FY2026 ending September 3, 2026; exact FY2027 fiscal calendar was not verified. Micron reported FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $74.33 and guided FQ1 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS of $37.84 ± $1.00. Annual FY2027 GAAP EPS sensitivity assumptions are $120/$150/$180, of which the arithmetic remainder after the $37.84 guide is $82.16/$112.16/$142.16 for the final three quarters; no interim FY2027 earnings have been reported, so these are not residuals from reported earnings nor consensus. Bear tests a sharp post-Q1 memory price/mix or margin normalization and multiple compression; base assumes sizable but moderating remaining AI-memory demand and retains a reverse-engineered multiple; bull tests continued tight supply, mix and margins. FY2026 GAAP net income was below operating income after taxes and non-operating items; this is total-GAAP sensitivity, not a recurring-operating-EPS model. Hypothetical P/E inputs are 5, 7.1659333333 (equals dated close at $150 EPS), and 9; none is observed, fair, or forecast.

cases.rationale: Assumes the $37.84 FQ1 GAAP midpoint is followed by $82.16 across the remaining three quarters, testing a sharp memory-cycle/margin normalization and de-rating.
Assumes the guided FQ1 midpoint plus $112.16 for the remaining three quarters; multiple is reverse-engineered to the dated close.
Assumes the guided FQ1 midpoint plus $142.16 for the remaining three quarters, testing continued AI-memory supply tightness, mix and margins with re-rating.
